title: Travessia or tracking taxes in a spreadsheet?
label: Taxes in a spreadsheet
description: Compare Travessia's monthly report with tracking payments, rates and tax invoices in a spreadsheet.

short.title: Short answer
short.text: A spreadsheet works with one or two clients. Past that, every month means looking up rates, tax invoices and checks by hand. Travessia puts it all in one report ready for your accountant.
short.note: If you get one payment a month and have time to check it, a spreadsheet still works.

rows.label: Rate for each payment
rows.us: Recorded the day the money lands
rows.them: You look it up and copy it

rows.label: Tax invoice
rows.them: You issue it and note the number

items.question: Can I import my spreadsheet history?
items.answer: Not yet. Reports start from your first payment through Travessia.

items.question: Does my accountant need an account?
items.answer: No. They get read-only access, without your account password.

items.question: What if I get paid outside Travessia too?
items.answer: Those payments stay out of the report. You can add them separately or bring those clients to Travessia.
